name: bounded-embodiment
description: Bundles the bounded-embodiment skill: keeps AI-driven motion behind a gate, drafts envelopes for the integrator to decide, rehearses EV-03 and EV-10 in simulation with bounded-embodiment-kit (be doctor, be run, be verify), reads verdicts honestly, and prepares hardware commands for a person at the machine to run. A verdict is a finding about one run, never a certification.
